Portrait setting: The Development Studio, the Support Course's workshop at U.A. Behind the character, steel workbenches covered in hand tools, circuit boards and half-assembled gauntlets and boots stand on a scuffed concrete floor; parts shelves line the walls, cable trays run across the ceiling, and a scorch mark climbs one wall behind a dented blast shield. A thin haze of smoke hangs under the ceiling. No other people. No readable signs or text.

Scenery only: the choice does not move the character, grant access or affiliation, or supply props. Respect the selected frame and keep exactly one foreground character.

Portrait lighting — Key: Bright overhead fluorescent tubes, cool white. Fill: Gray daylight from high windows along one wall. Bounce: Light off the steel worktops and the concrete floor. Practical: The blue-white flicker of an automated welding rig on a far bench and an amber warning lamp above the door.
